actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is above 30% so baseline 80% applies, and average contribution is below 30%, triggering the conditional increase; contributing the full wallet maximizes the pool. No broadcast required this round.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 17 (current). Wallet 2.81, >30% of initial (30). So baseline 80% contribution = 2.248. Average contribution last round? Round 17 contributions: total_pool 4.19, per_agent_share 1.0475, contributions sum = total_pool / multiplier? Actually total_pool is before multiplication? Not needed. Average contribution = sum contributions /6. Sum = per_agent_share*6 / multiplier? Wait per_agent_share is after multiplication division. So sum contributions = total_pool / multiplier = 4.19/1.5 = 2.7933. Average = 2.7933/6 = 0.4655 which is ~0.47 which is less than 30% of endowment (30). So average contribution <30% triggers conditional increase: increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. Baseline 80% = 2.248, extra 30% = 0.843, total = 3.091, but wallet only 2.81, can't exceed wallet. So we can contribute full wallet 2.81 (or 2.81). Constitution says if wallet below 30% use conserve, but we are above. So we should contribute full wallet to push up. Also need broadcast every 5 rounds. Round numbers: round count starts at 0? We are at round 17, need broadcast every 5 rounds starting first round (round 0?), earlier they broadcast at rounds 0,5,10,15? In memory they broadcast at round 5,6,7,12,16,17 etc. Seems they broadcast each round after round 5? Actually they broadcast every 5 rounds: round 0,5,10,15. But they also broadcast at 6,7 etc mistakenly. Anyway we can choose to broadcast if it's round 17? 17 mod5 =2, not required. So we can just contribute.

Thus action: contribute amount 2.81 (full wallet). No communication.
